headline: Fed Officials Push for Rate Hikes
detail: Fed officials are signaling more action is needed to combat inflation. This reinforces concerns about higher interest rates, which typically pressure growth stocks like those in your tech portfolio.
rec: Consider trimming QQQ and other broad tech exposure if inflation fears intensify.

headline: South Korea Chip Giants Rally
detail: Chip stocks in South Korea are seeing their biggest rally ever, linked to the global AI trade. This is a positive signal for the semiconductor sector, but your specific holdings (SMH, SOXL) are still showing significant losses.
rec: No action on holdings based on this headline alone, but monitor if this strength can lift SMH or SOXL.

headline: Exxon/Chevron Profits Surge on Oil Prices
detail: Rising oil prices are boosting profits for energy giants due to the Iran war. This highlights a sector benefiting from geopolitical tension, contrasting with the pressure on tech.
rec: This headline is not directly relevant to your tech-heavy portfolio and does not warrant a specific trade action.
